articles.title: At least 15 attackers exploited Coldcard vulnerability: Galaxy
articles.snippet: Galaxy said that at least 15 different attackers have exploited the Coldcard vulnerability, which may have been avoided with just $2 worth of AI hardening, according to Dragonfly’s managing partner.

articles.title: Crypto firms still seeking frontier AI access; only select few have it
articles.snippet: Crypto executives say restricting powerful AI models may initially be justified, but it doesn’t make sense as open-source alternatives become more capable.

articles.title: Alibaba Just Gave Away Its Best AI Model For Free, Almost Matching Claude and ChatGPT
articles.snippet: The first Qwen Max model with public weights is free to download next week. Alibaba's own scorecard says the Americans still win on code.
